header: These are the sources of a deep summary (EDS) taken from the search results: circulars AND announcements, in the order the search ranked them. A circular keeps its own number and gets its full text from its chunks; an announcement travels under its moved number (sourceKey.ts), its full text is its body and the text of its PDF, and it is named to the reader by its label. I do not treat a holiday note as a source. This is pure: the texts are given.
